reconstructed_theorem_text: Definition: for every measurable space X, measure mu on X, fixed Gamma : (X -> R) -> (X -> R), fixed admissible : (X -> R) -> Prop, and C in R, the target is P(mu,Gamma,admissible,C). Ent_m(h) means integral_X h(x) log(h(x)) dm(x) - (integral_X h(x) dm(x)) log(integral_X h(x) dm(x)). Every integral is a real Bochner integral over all X, not an extended-real integral; log(0) = 0. Lean totalizes the Bochner integral by assigning zero when integrability fails. P(m,G,D,c) means: for every f : X -> R, D(f), Integrable(f^2,m), Integrable(f^2 log(f^2),m), Integrable(G(f),m), and G(f) >= 0 m-almost everywhere imply Ent_m(f^2) <= 2 c integral_X G(f)(x) dm(x). G and D are fixed outside the test quantifier. This does not assert that every D-test has the stated integrability or sign. P is vacuous if no test satisfies every antecedent, including if D is empty. There is no implicit topology, smoothness, derivative, or structural condition on G. The definition requires neither mu to be a probability measure nor C to be nonnegative.
objects: X, mu, fixed energy-density map Gamma, fixed test predicate admissible, real C, and all real functions f on X.
domains: X is any measurable space; mu is any measure; Gamma : (X -> R) -> (X -> R); admissible : (X -> R) -> Prop; C : R with no sign restriction. Output is a proposition. All integrals are real over X.
quantifiers: For each choice of X, mu, Gamma, admissible, C, quantify every f : X -> R. Each test has its own conditional integrability and sign antecedents.
assumptions: For the inequality for a given f: admissible(f); Bochner integrability under mu of f^2, f^2 log(f^2), and Gamma(f); and Gamma(f) >= 0 mu-almost everywhere. No global probability, regularity, or sign restriction on C.
conclusion: For every test meeting all antecedents, integral_X f^2 log(f^2) dmu - (integral_X f^2 dmu) log(integral_X f^2 dmu) <= 2 C integral_X Gamma(f)(x) dmu(x).
scopes: Gamma and admissible are fixed before f is quantified. Integrability and nonnegative energy are premises for each individual f, not obligations asserted for all admissible tests. The predicate is vacuous if admissible is empty or no test satisfies all premises. No differentiability or gradient interpretation is imposed on Gamma. Entropy uses real Bochner integrals with log(0) = 0.
constant_dependencies: C is a supplied real parameter uniform over all qualifying f. The factor 2 is literal. The definition asserts no existence, positivity, optimality, or specific dependence of C.
